changelog:
Initial release of "概念八维度解剖 (Concept Anatomy)":

- Introduces an 8-dimension model (历史/辩证/现象/语言/形式/存在/美感/元反思) for deep, structured analysis of any concept.
- Guides users to synthesize a one-sentence core insight (≤ 30 characters) after multi-angle dissection.
- Provides clear input rules, output format, application boundaries, and workflow with upstream/downstream skill integration.
- Clearly distinguishes from standard definitions or flat explanations (e.g., "百度一下").
- Includes user trigger words, example formats, and reference demos for practical usage.
summary: 用 8 个维度（历史/辩证/现象/语言/形式/存在/美感/元反思）解剖任意概念，最终浓缩为一句核心顿悟。 触发词：「解剖概念」「学概念」「搞懂」「学懂」「concept-anatomy」
